justifications.type_expressiveness: Uses a newtype JobId, a proper JobState enum, and a typed QueueError with distinguishing variants; internal Job struct uses Option<Instant> rather than encoding state-dependent data in the JobState enum itself.
justifications.error_handling: Typed error enum with informative variants and Display/Error impls; uses an assert! in new() and an expect("job exists") without a documented safety comment, plus saturating fallbacks rather than propagating overflow.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Public surface is reasonable with sensible derives and a Display impl, but there are no doc comments on any public items and no derives like Default or Clone where they might be useful.
justifications.idiomaticity: Generally idiomatic with ?, ok_or, matches! in tests, and proper derives, but the checkout loop manually scans and clones the payload rather than using iterator methods, and uses a verbose match instead of get/and_then patterns.
